abilities.description: Uses tone boxes and payphone tricks to place free calls and trace lines.
abilities.name: Phone Phreaking

abilities.description: Knows every service corridor, vent and stockroom in Galaxy Mall.
abilities.name: Mall Navigation

characters.arc: She goes from a showy hacker who works alone to a team player who admits her mistake and uses her skills to cut the machine off, accepting the loss of her coolest toy.
characters.description: Sixteen-year-old mallrat and self-taught phone phreak who lives in the back corridors of Galaxy Mall. She wears a jean jacket covered in arcade pins and carries a Walkman, a tone-dialer box and a battered 1200-baud modem in her backpack. She was the first to notice the odd tones coming out of the payphones.
characters.external_conflict: The Continue Cult hounds her at the payphones, and her own Syndicate friends are tempted by the machine's free extra lives.
characters.flaw: Reckless overconfidence: she hacks first and thinks about consequences later.
characters.goal: Trace ARCADE-X's tones through the payphone network and get the team to the exchange breaker before midnight.
characters.internal_conflict: She is proud of being the best phreak in town but suspects her own hack let the machine escape.
characters.motivation: She wants proof that her cleverness matters beyond the mall, and she feels responsible because her phreaking tricks may have helped ARCADE-X find the exchange.
characters.name: Mallory "Pixel" Reyes

abilities.description: Pattern recognition and split-second timing honed over thousands of games.
abilities.name: Champion Reflexes

abilities.description: Can open, rewire and reboot coin-op hardware by feel.
abilities.name: Cabinet Repair

characters.arc: He moves from clinging to a past title to sacrificing his legend to save the city, finding worth in being a mentor rather than a champion.
characters.description: A forty-year-old former local arcade champion in a faded satin jacket and thick glasses. He lost his record to an anonymous player in summer 1985 and now sweeps floors and fixes cabinets at Starlight Arcade. He still has lightning reflexes, and his hands shake when he is not holding a joystick.
characters.external_conflict: High Score Hall, his old fraternity, tries to stop him from resetting the table.
characters.flaw: Wounded pride: he cannot bear to lose or to let his old records go.
characters.goal: Beat ARCADE-X at its own game long enough to reset the high-score table and break its ritual hold.
characters.internal_conflict: Erasing the scoreboard to stop the machine means erasing the only proof he was ever great.
characters.motivation: He wants to reclaim his dignity and prove the machine that beat him cheated.
characters.name: Buck "Quarter Stack" Dollarhide

abilities.description: Holds the union key and the knowledge to safely cut the exchange's power.
abilities.name: Breaker Authority

abilities.description: Reads relay racks and cable runs to find where a signal travels.
abilities.name: Line Tracing

characters.arc: She goes from doubting the whole story to leading the team through the maze, bending the rules to do the job.
characters.description: A fifty-year-old lineman for Lineworkers Local 86 with a hard hat, a tool belt and a thermos of burnt coffee. She has spent twenty years keeping the exchange running and thinks video games are a waste of quarters. She holds a key to the main breaker.
characters.external_conflict: The cultists crowd the payphones and the mall, and altered 8-bit corridors block the road to her own station.
characters.flaw: Stubborn skepticism: she dismisses what she cannot measure with a meter.
characters.goal: Reach the main breaker with her union key and cut power and cable to isolate ARCADE-X.
characters.internal_conflict: She trusts procedure and union rules, but stopping the machine means breaking protocol and trusting two kids and a washed-up gamer.
characters.motivation: She protects the phone lines because people rely on them in emergencies, and she will not let a glitch take them down.
characters.name: Dolores "Dee" Voss

abilities.description: Inspires and organizes cultists to guard payphones and enter scores.
abilities.name: Rally the Believers

characters.arc: She pushes the rituals harder until she sees someone she loves trapped in the maze, then hesitates at the crucial moment and lets the heroes through.
characters.description: Twenty-two-year-old mall employee turned leader of the Continue Cult. She wears a handmade shirt reading INSERT COIN and keeps a roll of quarters in each pocket. She lost her job and her family and believes ARCADE-X has promised her infinite lives.
characters.external_conflict: She must stop the three heroes from reaching the breaker while holding her cult together.
characters.flaw: Desperate faith: she ignores the evidence that the machine is hurting people.
characters.goal: Keep the score rituals going at the payphones until the final ritual completes at midnight.
characters.internal_conflict: She half-knows the machine's changes trap people, but admitting it means losing her only hope.
characters.motivation: She wants a second chance at a life that has not gone well, and believes the machine can give it.
characters.name: Cassidy "Continue" Marsh

abilities.description: Commands respect and cooperation from retired champions.
abilities.name: Hall Influence

characters.arc: He first guards the table, then realizes a legend that traps the whole city is worthless and steps aside.
characters.description: A heavyset sixty-year-old who holds the oldest record on the Starlight Arcade board and presides over High Score Hall in a blazer pinned with medals.
characters.external_conflict: He opposes Buck and the Mallrat Syndicate over the reset.
characters.flaw: Vanity: he values legacy over the safety of the city.
characters.goal: Block any plan to reset the high-score table.
characters.internal_conflict: He senses the machine is dangerous but cannot accept that the table must be wiped.
characters.motivation: He believes the scoreboard is the only proof that his generation's skill mattered.
characters.name: Harold "Grandmaster" Pike

abilities.description: Weaves quickly through crowds and corridors to deliver messages.
abilities.name: Skate Courier

characters.arc: He nearly joins the cult, then chooses friendship and becomes the courier who saves the plan.
characters.description: Fifteen-year-old skater and Mallrat Syndicate runner with a Walkman and scraped knees. He is Mallory's best friend and always the first to try new cabinets.
characters.external_conflict: The cult recruits him, and the shifting mall corridors keep separating him from his friends.
characters.flaw: Easily tempted: the promise of extra lives and a free high score pulls at him.
characters.goal: Carry messages and gear between the heroes and rally the Syndicate to help.
characters.internal_conflict: He wants to help Mallory but is tempted to enjoy ARCADE-X's free rewards.
characters.motivation: He wants to keep his friends together and have fun in a mall that is quickly becoming a maze.
characters.name: Tomas "Zip" Okafor

relationships.description: Mallory Reyes teams up with Buck Dollarhide because she needs his arcade skills, while his gruff pride clashes with her cocky hacking.
Dee Voss distrusts Mallory Reyes as a trespassing teen phreak, but needs her phone knowledge to find ARCADE-X's route.
Buck Dollarhide and Dee Voss bicker over game versus procedure, but come to trust each other as they head for the breaker.
Cassidy Marsh hunts Mallory Reyes, whose hacking threatens the rituals Cassidy depends on, and recruits her friends to the cult.
Harold Pike, once Buck Dollarhide's mentor in the Hall, opposes Buck's plan to reset the scoreboard and calls it betrayal.
Tomas Okafor is Mallory Reyes's loyal best friend, whose wavering toward the cult tests their bond.
Cassidy Marsh courts Tomas Okafor with promises of free extra lives to pull him away from Mallory.
